courses.title: Programming Fundamentals
courses.description: Introductory programming in Python for students with no prior experience.

outcomes.text: Write Python programs using variables, conditionals and loops.
Decompose problems into functions and call them correctly.
Use lists and dictionaries to store and process data.
Read and write text files from a program.
Test and debug small programs systematically.

courses.title: Introduction to Computing Concepts
courses.description: Survey of computing: hardware, networks, ethics and productivity software. No programming required.

outcomes.text: Describe the main components of a computer system.
Explain how networks and the internet work at a high level.
Discuss ethical and societal issues in computing.
Use spreadsheet and presentation software effectively.

courses.title: Applied Statistics
courses.description: Statistical methods for applied problems including regression.

outcomes.text: Summarise data with descriptive statistics and graphs.
Work with common probability distributions.
Construct and interpret confidence intervals.
Carry out hypothesis tests for means and proportions.
Fit and interpret simple and multiple linear regression models.
Apply techniques of integration.
Evaluate improper integrals.
Test infinite series for convergence.
Represent functions with power series.

courses.title: Academic Writing
courses.description: Writing and research skills for university coursework.

outcomes.text: Develop a clear thesis and structure an academic argument.
Locate and evaluate scholarly sources.
Cite sources correctly and avoid plagiarism.
Revise writing for clarity and style.

courses.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Core data structures and algorithm analysis.

outcomes.text: Implement arrays, linked lists, stacks and queues.
Implement and analyse trees and hash tables.
Implement sorting and searching algorithms.
Analyse running time using Big-O notation.
Apply graph traversal algorithms.
Model data with the relational model and relational algebra.
Write SQL queries including joins and aggregation.
Normalise relational schemas to third normal form.
Explain transactions, concurrency control and recovery.
Explain indexing and query processing basics.

courses.title: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence
courses.description: Design of data warehouses and analytical reporting.

outcomes.text: Explain data warehouse architecture and dimensional modelling.
Design ETL processes to load a warehouse.
Build OLAP cubes and analytical dashboards.
Evaluate data quality for reporting.

courses.title: Capstone Project
courses.description: Two-semester team software project. Restricted: capstone courses are not eligible for transfer credit.

outcomes.text: Deliver a substantial software project as a team.
Manage requirements, planning and risk.
Present and defend the final product.

courses.title: Internship
courses.description: Supervised industry placement. Restricted: internships are not eligible for transfer credit.

outcomes.text: Complete a supervised industry placement.
Reflect on professional practice in a written report.
